test_policy.notes: SJSU (a CSU campus) does not use SAT/ACT in admission decisions; the CDS C8A marks them 'not considered'. SJSU's international steps page still says SAT/ACT scores are 'encouraged' (Step 9, optional), which conflicts with the CDS; treat scores as not needed. Admission is based on a converted U.S. GPA of at least 3.0 plus college-prep course requirements.

requirements.notes: Apply through Cal State Apply (not the Common App). No essays or recommendations are used (CDS C7). Needs a converted U.S. GPA of 3.0+, 4 years of college-prep English (if English is the medium of instruction) and 3 years of college-prep math with C- or better, and partial official high school transcripts; final transcripts due July 15, 2027. All majors are impacted, so some require a higher GPA than 3.0. Animation and Illustration applicants add three drawing exercises.

deadlines.label: International first-year application deadline, Cal State Apply (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Cal State Apply opens Aug 1, 2026 and submissions open Oct 1, 2026; the domestic first-year deadline is Nov 30, 2026 but international first-year applicants have until Apr 1, 2027. Partial transcripts due Mar 23, 2027. CDS C16: admission decisions are sent on a rolling basis beginning Feb 15, so earlier is safer because majors can fill.

deadlines.label: International document deadline
deadlines.notes: Outstanding documents and English test scores on the MySJSU To Do List are due by this date.

deadlines.label: Intent to Enroll deadline and orientation fee
deadlines.notes: Housing application deadline is also May 1 ($50 application fee and $300 initial payment).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if the school's medium of instruction is not English. Waived with 60 semester/90 quarter transferable units at a U.S. college, 3 years of full-time study at a U.S. college, or 3 years full-time at an institution where English is the primary language of instruction; 'O' level exams passed in one sitting (5 subjects incl. Math and English, not ESL English) also waive the test. Scores older than 2 years are not valid and must be sent electronically by the testing center.

english.notes: Tests taken before Jan 21, 2026 (0-120 scale), non-engineering majors. All Engineering majors: 80. TOEFL Home Edition accepted.
Exams on/after Jan 21, 2026 (1-6 scale), non-engineering majors. All Engineering majors: 4.
No separate Engineering minimum is listed.

aid.notes: SJSU's financial aid office says international students are eligible only for merit-based scholarships; need-based aid is unavailable to them. No amounts or international-specific scholarship names are published on that page. SJSU's international-programs page also mentions International Gateways, which offers academic and TOEFL preparation courses on campus; no conditional-admission pathway is described on the page.

cost.notes: Computed from published rates: full-time undergraduate tuition $3,419 per semester plus nonresident tuition $471 per unit (Fall 2026 and Spring 2027), assuming 15 units a term; fees from the Bursar page. Room and board is campus housing $15,543 plus food $7,369; other = transportation $1,121 plus personal $2,900 (SJSU 2026-27 budget, marked draft). Total = SJSU's $37,735 campus-housing budget plus $14,130 nonresident tuition (30 units). International students must also buy CSU-provided health insurance (cost not found).

majors.notes: Applicants are ranked in the chosen major and an alternate major; engineering applicants are ranked with a modified eligibility index that adds math GPA. Engineering majors also have higher English minimums (TOEFL 80 / new scale 4, IELTS 6.5, PTE 53).
Requires three short supplemental drawing exercises due one week after the application deadline; otherwise only the alternate major is considered.

sat.note: SJSU school code for SAT results (SAT is not used in admission decisions).

act.note: ACT scores are not used in admission and no ACT code is listed on SJSU's admissions pages.

toefl.note: SJSU school code for TOEFL results; scores must be sent electronically by ETS after you submit the Cal State Apply application.

ielts.note: Submit IELTS through your Cal State Apply application (no SJSU-specific code).
